eval_01: Move to higher ground immediately. Avoid walking or driving through floodwater. Turn off main utilities.
eval_02: Water (1 gal per person per day), 3-day non-perishable food, flashlight, first-aid kit, power bank, documents.
eval_03: Drop, Cover, and Hold On under a sturdy table. Stay away from glass and heavy objects.
eval_04: Get out and stay out immediately. Crawl low under smoke. Test doors before opening.
eval_05: Board up windows, secure loose outdoor objects, charge devices, store clean drinking water, monitor weather radio.
eval_06: Move to higher floors or roof. Turn off electricity. Signal for emergency help using bright cloth or whistle.
eval_07: 72-hour Go-Bag containing water, food, first-aid kit, flashlight, emergency whistle, prescription drugs, power bank.
eval_08: Place heel of hand in center of chest, push hard and fast at 100-120 compressions per minute.
